interpretation: Direction match is good (dy error ~0.005), but s_x=s_y=0 gives large dx/dz errors because perspective CMO-style d_x variation is missing. Adding s_x,s_y helps but the full rayfield RMS remains high because origin errors (|O_z - O_tc| ≈ 0.5mm) and the two-plane residual amplifies small angular errors at Z=50,80mm.
